title: Blue Tulip
body:
"Blue tulips are elegant flowers that symbolize tranquility and peace."

Description

The Blue Tulips are sellable common flowers, that can be found around in the Finlay and Flowering Meadows regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 25$ per tulip. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.92% per flower.
